import re

def validate_iam_username(username):
    pattern = r'^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9\-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?(([\.]?[a-z0-9]))^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9\-]{0,61}([a-z0-9]))?)?$'
    if re.match(pattern, username):
        return True
    else:
        return False

# example usage
print(validate_iam_username("john-doe"))  # returns True
print(validate_iam_username("JohnDoe"))  # returns False
print(validate_iam_username("johndoe12345678901234567890123456789012345678901234567890"))  # returns False
print(validate_iam_username("johndoe-"))  # returns False
print(validate_iam_username("johndoe."))  # returns False
